## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was on v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. ## Final state

- **Version:** v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west)
- **Health:** healthy ✅
- **Error rate:** 0.002 (down from 0.18)

The incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up investigation into the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure.
